facts.fact: POTRAZ says 831 organisations are formally recognised as compliant with Zimbabwe's Cyber and Data Protection Act, which is being applied.

POTRAZ, led by Director General Gift Machengete with a data protection director, acts as the country's data protection authority and was nominated by SADC to lead regional data protection capacity building in 2026.

POTRAZ reports 831 organisations recognised as compliant, 12 implementing guidelines issued (including on compliance assessments and data breach management), 30 data controller awareness trainings held and 24 cross-border transfers authorised.
